_comment: Agentic Command Center - the single process dial. Hooks re-read this on every fire, so edits take effect immediately with no restart.

context._note: STANDING (2026-07-31, Kyle, set via the ACC dials + chat instruction; SUPERSEDES the 2026-07-30 100/150 standing): 400/600 until he manually changes it again. These dials are the ONLY source of context limits for EVERY session, ACC-launched or not - profiles carry no context overrides, so the number saved here is what budget.mjs enforces and statusline.mjs displays. softK MUST stay below hardK: budget.mjs returns allow() at 'ctx < softK*1000' before it ever tests hardK, so a softK above hardK silently disables the UserPromptSubmit and PostToolUse checks and leaves only the Stop hook. Measured baseline start context is ~35-42k (CLAUDE.md + memory index + tools). hardK is the TOTAL context ceiling, not headroom above baseline.

week._note: Tier counts usage from effectiveFrom onward (ACC install), so the switch cannot fire retroactively on pre-discipline burn. Baseline for reference: 2.35B tokens/7d before ACC. amber ~52% / red ~78% of that.

subagents._note: Implementation work belongs in a runner session (fresh context, cheap), not an Opus subagent. Multi-finder fan-out needs an explicit time-boxed grant: 'node hooks/budget.mjs fanout 30' or the Command Center Process tab.

rates._note: $ per million tokens, used for RELATIVE attribution in reports. These are list API prices, not subscription billing truth. Correct them here and every report follows.

autoClear._note: Outside watcher (watcher/clearbot.ps1) types /clear as real keystrokes when a session ends over hardK. Hooks cannot clear context themselves. false = fall back to telling Kyle to type it.

goals._note: A goal (runner/goals/) carries work across a /clear: SessionStart adopts it by CONSOLE PID and injects it, the Stop hook logs the cycle, clearbot types a constant to restart the turn. Kyle's call 2026-07-31: unbounded - the loop ends only when the model runs 'goal.mjs done <id>' or 'blocked <id>'. maxCycles 0 = no cap; set a number to stop after N continuations. A RED week tier holds all resumes regardless. Liveness (2026-07-31): a turn ending UNDER budget also re-arms the kick, so the loop no longer dies when a session simply finishes its turn - kickSettleSeconds is how long after a turn end a kick may fire, humanHoldMinutes is how long a prompt Kyle typed suppresses it (it expires, so walking away self-heals).

autoApprove._note: The Command Center runs pending runbox scripts itself instead of waiting for a human /approve (Kyle, 2026-07-31). Scripts marked [keep] are NEVER auto-run - they stay in the runbox after running, so auto-running them would loop forever. A failed script is attempted once per watcher lifetime and then left alone. Every run is appended to watcher/approvals.log. This does NOT touch the secrets list guard.mjs protects.

profiles._note: Chosen in the Command Center 'Start work' tab. The launcher sets ACC_PROFILE=<name>; budget.mjs and statusline.mjs (both via usage.mjs applyProfile) apply the SUBAGENT overrides for THAT SESSION only. Context limits ALWAYS come from the base dials above - single source of truth since 2026-07-31; do not add context blocks back here, they would shadow the Process-tab dials. Sessions with no ACC_PROFILE use the base policy unchanged.

Normal.label: The standard setup. Use this unless you have a reason not to.

Heavy.label: More helpers. For long migrations and audits.

autoCd._note: route.mjs blocks a prompt whose scope differs from cwd, writes a cd request, and the clearbot types /cd (plus /clear on a mid-session re-scope) then replays the prompt. enabled:false = advisory line only, no blocking and no typing.
